Amazon's $50 AirPods Pro 3 discount is still rolling, and the retailer has now relaunched launch-day savings on the M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio, alongside updated deals for the early fall Prime Day sale. Today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also brings some of the first Amazon all-time low clearance deals on Apple Watch Ultra 3 at $200 off, alongside exclusive discounts on iPhone 18 Pro cases, all-new SANDMARC 3-in-1 glare, exposure and mist filters for iPhone 18 Pro, and much more. And don't miss the all-new Beats 360 ANC headphones and modular Cushion Kits at 20% off.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (originally $249)

Amazon Early Fall Prime Day Deals live: Apple, Pixel, Anker, Grubhub $20 off, more

Apple Watch Ultra 3 clearance deal now live, $200 off (Amazon all-time low)

We are still tracking some early launch-week savings on the all-new Apple Watch Ultra 4 below, but Amazon is now offering a brand new all-time low clearance price on Apple Watch Ultra 3 — the Natural and Black Milanese Loop variants are now nearly $200 off their original prices.

Amazon is now shipping Black Titanium and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models paired with the Titanium Milanese Loop for $699.97 with free shipping.

These configurations, the same as comparable models in the Ultra 4 lineup, carry $899 MSRPs and are both now down to Amazon all-time lows:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $700 (originally $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $700 (originally $899)

Prior to today's Amazon clearance deals, we'd never seen either model go for less than $749 there, but anything below $800 has been quite rare — we'd only ever caught it dipping to that level once before.

Apple Watch Ultra 4 does bring some notable upgrades and improvements, but in my view, for everyone except the most hardcore Ultra users and fitness enthusiasts, the third generation remains a wearable that's more than up to the task. Our Apple Watch Ultra 4 vs Ultra 3 comparison feature has all the details.

All-new M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio launch deals now live, up to nearly $50 off

Apple has now officially unveiled its latest headless Macs, including the all-new 2026 M6 Mac mini and M5 Max Mac Studio. And Amazon has now brought back launch-day discounts, with nearly $50 off on almost every configuration, delivering the lowest prices available.

These aren't massive discounts, of course, but we're talking about machines that just went on sale this week, and for early adopters this is already the lowest pricing out there:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (originally $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (originally $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (originally $1,299)

While the launch-day deal on the 24GB M5 Pro Mac mini hasn't returned, we're also seeing nearly $50 off on the all-new 2026 Mac Studio with M5 Max chip today:

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,450 (originally $2,499)

All of the above savings match the best cash discounts we've tracked to date.

All-new Beats 360 ANC headphones launch deals: modular Cushion Kits from $10 at 20% off

As we mentioned yesterday in a larger Beats sale roundup, Apple-owned brand has now officially launched the all-new Beats 360 over-ear headphones with a modular design featuring swappable ear cushions and headband pads. The product is now available for order, and we're also seeing some Beats 360 launch deals — with the Beats 360 Cushion Kits on sale for as little as $9.99.

Beats 360 launch deals

The all-new Beats 360 headphones feature a modular design, allowing users to swap and replace ear cushions and headband pads. The headphones themselves certainly ship with one matching set of pads, but you can now pick up the seven different colorways of Beats 360 Cushion Kits at a discount to mix and match your style, or swap in a fresh set after a workout.

  • Beats 360 over-ear headphones $350
  • Beats 360 Cushion Kit $10 (originally $50)

The Beats 360 Cushion Kit includes a pair of ear cushions plus one headband pad. They come in six different Performance Knit styles, and one UltraPlush option for a more traditional Beats feel (sort of tumbling leather-like).

The all-new Beats 360 takes over as the flagship over-ear headphones in the lineup, offering "1.75x more" noise cancellation than the Beats Studio Pro, personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking, beamforming microphones that filter out background noise during calls, and IPX4 protection — making the Beats 360 the brand's first sweat- and water-resistant over-ear headphones. It also supports Hey Siri and Find My.

Mid-tier 13-inch M5 MacBook Air model now $150 off at Amazon

Beyond the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deals, Amazon is now offering a chance to grab a mid-tier 13-inch M5 MacBook Air for $150 off.

Amazon is shipping the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and an upgraded 1TB of storage for $1,449 with free shipping.

It normally retails for $1,599 and is now $150 off, making it one of the best discounts we've tracked since the price hike a few months back. Not every colorway is at this price right now, but for that money you can grab the classic Silver, Sky Blue, and Starlight models.

When it comes to the timing for the M5 MacBook Air lineup right now, any discount close to $150 is decent. $100 off wouldn't be bad, but what we're really hoping for is something closer to $150 off, especially on any upgraded model.

The base model isn't seeing any notable discounts right now, but Amazon also has the 13-inch with 24GB RAM and 1TB storage at $1,649 with free shipping — also $150 off the regular price.

15-inch M5 MacBook Air models up to $300 off right now at Apple Certified Refurbished Store

While we're tracking today's $150 discounts on brand new 13-inch M5 MacBook Air models at Amazon, if you act fast, Apple Certified Refurbished Store also has some solid deals on 15-inch models — we're tracking up to $300 off right now. Details below.

Apple Certified Refurbished Store has the cheapest 2026 Studio Display at $240 off while supplies last

Over the past few weeks, we've caught some decent deals on the 2026 Apple Studio Display over at Amazon, but Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now offering a rare discount on the most basic model, $240 below the original price.

Apple Certified Refurbished Store is currently shipping the 2026 Apple Studio Display with a tilt-adjustable stand for $1,359 with free shipping.
